typography.usage: Titles and short section openings; source slide 9 / headline.
Reading text, supporting labels and detailed explanations; source slide 9 / page.

recognitionRules: Use a pencil-and-paper cover with a quiet text field.
Pair Trebuchet headings with Arial instructional detail.
Use violet and pale lavender with lime reserved for focused learning cues.
Show the lesson map and success criteria before practice.
Keep alternative response modes visible alongside the task.

principles: Use short action sentences; follow an invitation with a concrete material, choice or check.
Use the identity’s sample as a rhythm and vocabulary reference, not as a factual project claim.
voice.sample: Try the task. Name the choice. Explain the reason.
voice.sampleStatus: Original fictional brand copy authored for this guide, not a quotation or factual claim.
avoid: Avoid promises that every participant will master the skill.
Avoid invented testimonials, performance claims and quotation attribution.
voice.secondaryExample: Try one version, then compare it with the criterion.
voice.cadence: Short opening, concrete follow-through; vary sentence length for explanation.

logoDirection: Use A TASK TO TRY in Trebuchet with a short pencil-like diagonal stroke outside the wordmark. No graduation cap or achievement badge.
invariants: Use a pencil-and-paper cover with a quiet text field.
Pair Trebuchet headings with Arial instructional detail.
Use violet and pale lavender with lime reserved for focused learning cues.
adaptations: A short demonstration retains task, example and check.
Participant sheets remove presenter navigation while preserving success criteria.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.

fonts.sourceFontDependency: Trebuchet MS is a separately licensed Microsoft/system font; not bundled.
Arial is a separately licensed Microsoft/system font; not bundled.

clearSpaceRule: Keep one half of the main wordmark cap height clear around the full silhouette, including its source-derived supporting device.

minimumSize.status: production minimum based on rendered 220/180px wordmark and 32/64px symbol inspection; verify again for unusual substrates
